title: genai assessment provenance: stamp every Feedback from a scorer with add_scorer_metadata, including error feedback, merging existing metadata
answers: Which metadata keys identify the scorer and version that produced an assessment?
I added a new scorer execution path; how do I make its feedback record the scorer version?
Assessment metadata from a scorer lost its existing keys after I set scorer provenance
Where are scorer assessments written with mlflow.assessment.scorerName?
body:
Path: Every place a registered or custom scorer turns its result into Feedback before logging it to a trace or session: harness scoring in mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:_compute_eval_scores, session-level scoring in mlflow/genai/evaluation/session_utils.py (both the success and exception branches of run_scorer), and online error assessments in mlflow/genai/scorers/online/trace_processor.py:_log_error_assessments.
Rule: Call mlflow/genai/evaluation/utils.py:add_scorer_metadata(scorer, feedbacks) on the feedback list before logging. It is a no-op when scorer.scorer_version is None. Otherwise it merges AssessmentMetadataKey.SCORER_NAME (mlflow.assessment.scorerName) and AssessmentMetadataKey.SCORER_VERSION (mlflow.assessment.scorerVersion, stored as a string) into the existing feedback.metadata, keeping keys the scorer already set. Keys are defined in mlflow/tracing/constant.py:AssessmentMetadataKey.
Symptom: Assessments from registered scorers that failed (error feedback) or from session-level scorers were recorded without the scorer name and version, so the exact scorer version that produced them could not be identified.
Constraints: Use the helper on error feedback too, not only on successful results. Do not overwrite existing feedback.metadata; the helper copies it. Non-registered scorers (no version) are untouched. UI rendering of these keys is not part of this contract.
applies: Any new code path in mlflow/genai that converts a scorer's output or failure into Feedback assessments on traces or sessions.
says: Trace evaluation feedback is missing the scorer name and version that produced it.
Failed evaluator runs log error assessments without recording which judge version failed.
Custom metadata on evaluation assessments disappears when scorer provenance is attached.
Session-level evaluation assessments do not display which registered scorer generated them.
Include the scorer name and version on all trace assessments including failure reports.
search: Every code path logging scorer outputs or errors as feedback must call `mlflow.genai.evaluation.utils.add_scorer_metadata(scorer, feedbacks)` before writing assessments to a trace or session. If `scorer.scorer_version` is present, the helper merges `AssessmentMetadataKey.SCORER_NAME` (`mlflow.assessment.scorerName`) and `AssessmentMetadataKey.SCORER_VERSION` (`mlflow.assessment.scorerVersion`) into `feedback.metadata` while preserving existing metadata keys. This applies to harness evaluation (`_compute_eval_scores`), session evaluation (`run_scorer` success and failure branches), and online error assessments (`_log_error_assessments`). The function is a no-op for non-registered scorers without a version, must be called on error feedback as well as successes, and does not govern UI rendering.
